While the screen resolution is above that of the best iphone it is still not the highest density pixel count you can find. Screen size is 1440p and wider than Sony's 4K screen which makes it difficult to hold but easier to view. Screen brightness stronger than other phones. Button placement is better than Sony but they stick out too much so when you place in pocket they easily get pressed unintentionally (cause its already so wide) which leads to quicker wear. Standy battery is better than Sony, and Samsung android doesnt have bugs like auto brightness turning itself on all the time. Flat screen is better than curved edge BUT the camera punch-hole is still present, while Sony display is not interrupted. The aspect ratio is also not standardized so viewing ultra wide movies has a cropped image while Sony's fills up the entire screen. It is improved device but still has steps to go. For pure media content i prefer Sony display, while for gps and other utilitarian use the s24u is better equipped. Camera on s23u felt like it made better images. Speaker and haptic quality is better on Sony, but it's louder on Samsung, infact too loud when others using max volume near me i have to always ask them to turn it down cause it hurts. Speaker holes on body dont have screen mesh you need to find that seperately, but atleast placement allows it, while Sony forward facing speaker design leaves no room for speaker mesh screen. I would prefer more affordable without stylus, and with memory card slot like the Sony phone has it. Display colors intensity/contrast does look totally washed out in a side-by-side comparison with the s23u. Finding accessories like cases and bags that fit perfectly with more variability to design choices to fit individual needs is infinitely easier than finding the same for Sony.
